verdict.rationale: Phaser ships a dedicated Game Agent MCP server with 40+ specialized tools that let AI agents perform editor-equivalent actions (particle emitters, layering, renaming, filters, physics tweaks) via plain-language commands, giving strong API/agent parity with the visual Editor's UI capabilities. However, this is first-party marketing copy only, with no independent verification that all Editor UI features (visual filter tuning, animation tweaking, SFX/music generation) are exposed 1:1 via API/MCP, and the docs.phaser.io probes show no public OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs confirming full coverage. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of full feature parity between Editor UI and MCP/API tools, and a public OpenAPI/machine-readable spec proving complete API surface coverage.
